top_signals.title: New parcel surcharge helps Postal Service reach $20B in revenue
top_signals.summary:
The U.S. Postal Service lost $2.5 billion in the fiscal third quarter, but revenues were up thanks to a new fee on parcel shipments and higher stamp prices.

The post New parcel surcharge helps Postal Service reach $20B in revenue appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
